test: Every row the strategy consumes must cite an official or licensed source; no third-party tables in the system of record
pass_criterion: 100% of inputs listed with a source and a licence position

test: Every input has a timestamped filing and cannot be overwritten by a later fetch
pass_criterion: Zero silent overwrites across a season

test: The strategy's record settles under one published venue rulebook
pass_criterion: Rulebook version recorded; pushes and ties defined

test: Rule, stake, market and sample target locked before the first graded bet
pass_criterion: Lock timestamp precedes first bet timestamp

test: The closed-form sample-size target for the observed effect is met
pass_criterion: n >= target computed from the strategy's own variance

test: Bonferroni or an equivalent correction across every test the registry has run
Performance survives a chronological split-half and a season-to-season check
pass_criterion: Both halves positive; second season positive

test: Cluster bootstrap interval on the strategy's mean return excludes zero
Performance compared with a closing line where one exists
Stake size does not move the price the strategy claims
pass_criterion: Stake below the declared market capacity

test: Parlay and prop-combo entries use a measured joint distribution, not an independence assumption
pass_criterion: Joint probabilities computed from same-game data
